jobs.title: ISU Billing - Functional Consultant III
jobs.description:
At VertexOne, helping utilities provide the best customer service experience is what we do. VertexOne is the recognized leader in SaaS platforms for utilities across North America. Through a wide range of innovative services and solutions, VertexOne helps utilities deliver a compelling customer experience; reducing the cost to serve customers, increasing operational efficiency, improving customer satisfaction, and driving utility operations forward. It’s been in the DNA of our people since we started supporting utilities’ customer experience needs over 20 years ago. And that commitment continues to this day.
  
  

Our team members are our greatest assets, so we pride ourselves on being ‘Employee First’. As such, we listen to what our employees have to say and find ways to incorporate their ideas into the company. Whether it’s new technology, career development opportunities, or fun events, we find new ways to keep our employees engaged and incentivized to grow within the company. Our employees' well\-being—both physical and mental—is a top priority at VertexOne. That's why we foster a 100% remote and flexible environment and encourage work\-life balance.
  
  

VertexOne is proudly Certified as a Great Place to Work®. Great Place to Work® is the global authority on workplace culture, employee experience, and leadership behaviors proven to deliver market\-leading revenue, employee retention and increased innovation. VertexOne is dedicated to prioritizing the employee experience and creating an exceptional company culture.
  
  

SAP IS\-U Billing Functional Consultant III
  
  

**Overview of Role/Job Purpose:**  

The SAP IS\-U Billing Functional Consultant III serves as a senior functional expert responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting complex SAP IS\-U Billing solutions for utility clients. This role leads requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, production support, and client engagement activities while mentoring junior consultants and driving delivery excellence across multiple client engagements. The consultant serves as a trusted advisor to clients, leads complex problem resolution efforts, and contributes to both enhancement initiatives and managed services support activities to ensure reliable and efficient operation of critical billing processes.
  
  

**Expertise in all aspects of Billing:**  

* Billing: Rates \& operand configuration
* Billing schemas
* Bill corrections
* Budget billing
* Invoicing
* Bill print forms


**Essential Duties:**  

* Collaborate with business users to gather, document, and analyze requirements for SAP enhancements and projects.
* Configure and support SAP Billing module to meet evolving business needs.
* Partcipate in all aspects of SAP enhancement delivery, including requirements gathering, documentation, testing, and deployment.
* Troubleshoot and resolve SAP\-related issues, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
* Develop functional specifications for technical teams and coordinate with developers on solution delivery.
* Maintain system documentation, process flows, and user guides.
* Support data integrity, reporting, and compliance initiatives across SAP systems.
* Stay current with SAP updates, best practices, and emerging technologies.
* Analyze and resolve production incidents affecting SAP IS\-U Billing processes.
* Support service requests, defect resolution, minor system enhancements and technical upgrades.
* Perform root cause analysis for billing issues.
* Execute and support testing activities for releases, upgrades, and production deployments.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams supporting FI\-CA, Device Management, and Customer Service processes.
* Ensure adherence to service\-level agreements and operational support procedures.
* Participate in on\-call support rotations as required.
* Serve as an escalation point for complex billing\-related issues.
* Build trusted advisor relationships with client stakeholders through regular operational reviews and proactive recommendations.


Required Qualifications
  
  

* 7\+ years of SAP IS\-U Billing functional experience.
* Hands\-on experience configuring SAP IS\-U Billing.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex implementations, enhancements, and AMS engagements.
* Strong experience with bill print form cofiguration, rate configuration, and billing exception analysis.
* Understanding of utility meter\-to\-cash business processes.
* Experience supporting production environments and troubleshooting billing\-related issues.
* Strong requirements gathering and functional documentation skills.
* Ability to assess impacts across Billing, FICA, Customer Service, and related SAP IS\-U processes.
* Strong client\-facing communication skills.
* Experience mentoring consultants and leading client\-facing workshops


Preferred
  
* SAP FI\-CA knowledge.
* SAP Device Management exposure.
* SAP S/4 Utilities experience.
* Experience working in a managed services or AMS organization.
* Jira ticket\-management platform experience.
* SAP Utilities industry background.


**Personal Attributes:**  

* Analytical: You break down complex problems and identify effective solutions.
* Business\-Minded: You understand how technology supports operational and strategic goals.
* Collaborative: You work well across teams and communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Detail\-Oriented: You ensure accuracy in configuration, documentation, and testing.
* Proactive: You anticipate issues, suggest improvements, and take initiative.
* Adaptable: You thrive in a dynamic environment and embrace continuous learning.


**What VertexOne has to offer:**  

* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance
* Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSAs)
* 401K match
* Flexible PTO
* Employee recognition platform with monetary rewards
* 100% Remote work environment
* Initial work from home stipend

jobs.title: SAP RAR & BRIM Business Analyst
jobs.location: Multiple (4): San Jose, CA, US, San Jose, CA, Dallas, TX, Pittsburgh, PA
jobs.description:
**Why Join Omnicell?**


Omnicell is transforming the future of healthcare technology through a strategic modernization of our global ERP and revenue management landscape. As we advance our SAP S/4HANA journey, we are seeking a highly experienced **SAP RAR \& BRIM Business Analyst** to shape the design and delivery of next\-generation revenue management capabilities.


In this high\-impact role, you will partner with Finance, Revenue Operations, Sales, Customer Experience, and IT leaders to enable scalable subscription\-based business models, streamline order\-to\-cash processes, and ensure revenue recognition compliance across a global organization. This is a unique opportunity to influence enterprise\-wide transformation initiatives while helping build the foundation for Omnicell's future growth.


**What You'll Do**


**Purpose**


Drive the architecture, design, and implementation of SAP Revenue Accounting \& Reporting (RAR) and SAP Billing \& Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM) solutions that support Omnicell's evolving business model, financial compliance requirements, and digital transformation objectives.


As a **SAP RAR \& BRIM Business Analyst**, you will:


**Primary Impact**


Lead the end\-to\-end design and optimization of revenue management and billing solutions that enable accurate financial reporting, operational scalability, and exceptional customer experiences.


* Lead the architecture, solution design, and implementation of SAP RAR and SAP BRIM capabilities across global business functions.
* Design and implement revenue recognition processes aligned with IFRS 15 and ASC 606 accounting standards.
* Configure and optimize SAP RAR functionality, including:
	+ Revenue Accounting Items (RAIs)
	+ Performance Obligations
	+ Standalone Selling Price (SSP) Allocation
	+ Contract Assets and Liabilities
	+ Revenue Deferrals
	+ Revenue Reporting and Reconciliation
* Architect SAP BRIM solutions supporting:
	+ Subscription Order Management (SOM)
	+ Convergent Invoicing (CI)
	+ FI\-CA
	+ Billing and Invoice Consolidation
	+ Contract Management
* Design and oversee integrations between SAP SD, FI/CO, BRIM, RAR, Salesforce, and other enterprise platforms.
* Lead migration initiatives from legacy and Sidecar RAR environments into SAP S/4HANA Embedded RAR.
* Develop solution roadmaps, functional specifications, configuration documentation, test strategies, deployment plans, and architectural standards.
* Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities for automation, process simplification, and operational excellence.
* Provide leadership throughout SIT, UAT, cutover, go\-live, and hyper care phases of transformational programs.
* Establish governance frameworks, solution standards, and SAP Revenue Management best practices.
* Mentor consultants and internal team members to expand organizational SAP RAR and BRIM expertise.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders on revenue management strategy and enterprise architecture decisions.

**Who You Are**


**Minimum Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
* 10\+ years of SAP functional, solution architecture, or enterprise application experience.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on SAP Revenue Accounting \& Reporting (RAR) implementation and support experience.
* 5\+ years of SAP BRIM implementation experience, including Subscription Order Management (SOM), Convergent Invoicing (CI), and FI\-CA.
* Deep expertise in Order\-to\-Cash, Billing, Revenue Recognition, Financial Accounting, and Revenue Operations processes.
* Experience designing and implementing BRF\+ revenue recognition rules and revenue allocation frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA architecture, integration patterns, and enterprise application landscapes.
* Proven experience leading large\-scale SAP transformation initiatives and collaborating with senior business and technology leaders.
* Exceptional communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* SAP certification in BRIM, RAR, SAP S/4HANA Finance, or related SAP disciplines.
* Experience migrating SAP Sidecar RAR solutions to Embedded RAR within SAP S/4HANA.
* Experience supporting subscription\-based, SaaS, healthcare technology, medical device, or recurring\-revenue business models.
* Experience with SAP Fiori, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) Integration Suite, Cloud ALM, and SAP Analytics solutions.
* Experience supporting global revenue recognition programs and multi\-company implementations.
* Knowledge of Salesforce integrations and enterprise billing ecosystems.
* Demonstrated ability to influence enterprise strategy and drive organizational change.

**How You'll Elevate at Omnicell**


At Omnicell, success is defined by both what you achieve and how you achieve it. As a **SAP RAR \& BRIM Business Analyst**, you will demonstrate our Elevate Behaviors every day:


**Collaborate**


Build strong partnerships across Finance, Revenue Operations, Sales, Customer Experience, and IT teams to deliver integrated, scalable business solutions.


**Inspire**


Influence stakeholders at all levels through thought leadership, architectural vision, and a commitment to achieving transformational business outcomes.


**Develop**


Embrace continuous learning within the SAP ecosystem while mentoring colleagues and strengthening internal RAR and BRIM capabilities.


**Execute**


Take ownership of critical program deliverables, establish clear priorities, and drive successful implementations from strategy through production support.


**Impact**


Shape the future of Omnicell's revenue management landscape by enabling innovative business models, improving compliance, and enhancing operational efficiency.


Drug Screen: Not Required


Base Compensation: $110,000\.00 to $175,000\.00

jobs.title: SAP Account Executive / Industry Account Executive
jobs.description:
**Benefits:**
* Bonus based on performance
* Competitive salary
**About the Role**
==================


Mobolutions is seeking an experienced SAP Account Executive / Industry Account Executive to build and grow strategic client relationships and drive revenue for our SAP consulting and professional services business. The ideal candidate brings a strong SAP background, an established network of enterprise decision\-makers, and the ability to identify opportunities, develop account strategies, and lead complex sales engagements from initial outreach through contract execution. This role combines new\-business development with relationship management and account growth.  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
=============================


* Develop and execute account plans to acquire new clients, expand existing relationships, and achieve assigned revenue and growth targets.


* Build and maintain trusted relationships with enterprise customers, including C\-level executives, CIOs, CTOs, business leaders, SAP leadership, and IT decision\-makers.


* Identify customer business priorities and position relevant SAP consulting, implementation, transformation, and related professional services solutions.


* Create and manage a qualified pipeline through targeted prospecting, networking, referrals, industry events, partner relationships, and other business\-development activities.


* Lead the end\-to\-end sales cycle, including account research, discovery, qualification, solution alignment, proposal development, presentations, RFP responses, negotiation, and deal closure.


* Work collaboratively with Mobolutions leadership, delivery, and solution teams to shape client solutions, scope engagements, develop estimates, and ensure proposed services align with client needs.


* Identify opportunities related to SAP S/4HANA transformation, SAP BRIM, BTP, Fiori, and other relevant SAP solutions based on client requirements and Mobolutions capabilities.


* Manage account relationships after the initial sale, maintain regular executive\-level engagement, and identify opportunities for follow\-on projects, additional services, and long\-term partnerships.


* Develop and maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline reports, account plans, and CRM records; communicate progress, risks, and sales priorities to leadership.


* Navigate professional\-services commercial processes, including MSAs, SOWs, pricing, terms, procurement requirements, and contract negotiations.


* Represent Mobolutions professionally in client meetings, industry forums, and relevant SAP ecosystem events; stay informed about SAP market developments and customer priorities.

  

**Required Qualifications**
===========================


* SAP background is a must, with substantial experience in SAP\-related services, solutions, consulting, or enterprise technology sales.


* 15\+ years of relevant experience in enterprise sales, account management, business development, or SAP services sales.


* Demonstrated success developing client relationships, generating qualified opportunities, and achieving measurable sales or revenue targets.


* Strong understanding of the SAP ecosystem, including SAP transformation and implementation engagements; familiarity with S/4HANA is expected.


* Experience engaging with senior business and technology stakeholders and translating business needs into consulting or solution opportunities.


* Ability to manage complex, consultative sales cycles and coordinate internal teams through solutioning, proposals, commercial discussions, and close.


* Working knowledge of professional services engagements and commercial documentation, including RFPs, MSAs, SOWs, and pricing negotiations.


* Excellent communication, presentation, relationship\-building, negotiation, and account\-planning skills.


* Willingness to work on\-site in Plano, TX, as needed and travel for client meetings when required.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================


* Established relationships with Fortune 500 or other large enterprise customers.


* Experience selling SAP S/4HANA, BRIM, BTP, Fiori, or related SAP consulting and transformation services.


* Prior experience with an SAP partner, systems integrator, or consulting services organization.


* A track record of opening net\-new accounts as well as growing and retaining strategic customer relationships.


* Experience selling across one or more industry verticals and developing account strategies around industry\-specific business challenges.

jobs.title: SAP Functional Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:** 




 The Senior SAP Functional analyst is responsible for translating the Business requirements of the Functional Area in two functional areas which is Billing \& Invoicing and FICA or DM performing the duties of systems analysis, design, and development the SAP system via the SAP Configuration IMG (SAP Implementation Guide). This includes all aspects of project work, on\-going functional enhancements, troubleshooting, and SAP provided system and/or legal changes. An SAP Senior Functional Analyst collaborates on all phases of the systems development life\-cycle (SDLC) with a focus on the analysis, design, and development of configuration\-based solutions. Must continuously maintain and develop the necessary skillsets, both technical and analytical to enhance value\-added business solutions and in keeping with the IT architecture.
 



 Under minimal supervision, is responsible for all aspects of the Systems Development Lifecycle (SDLC) in relation to SAP Configuration activities.
 



  





**PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** 




 Implements software solutions for which in\-depth configuration and integration is required; drives substantial interaction with vendor resources and integrates applications with complex interfaces based on specifications provided.
 



 Hands\-on experience in SAP IS\-U Billing \& Invoicing, with deep functional expertise across the meter\-to\-cash lifecycle in the utility industry (Electricity \& Gas).
 



 Expert in configuring and customizing billing master data i.e., billing schemas, rate modelling including complex billing, regulated and de\-regulated tariff models.
 



 Strong knowledge of the end\-to\-end billing and invoicing process including budget billing, RTP billing, TOU billing, mass batch jobs, exception management, bill simulation, unbilled revenue scenarios and collective billing.
 



 Working knowledge of SAP ISU Bill Print, including Print Workbench configuration and integration with Smart Forms and Adobe Forms.
 



 Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams including integration with Device Management and FICA.
 



 Extensive functional and solution experience with the ability to facilitate, design, and develop complex solutions aligned with digital transformation initiatives.
 



 Strong client\-facing skills – ability to serve as a functional liaison between business and IT. Guide stakeholders on best practices.
 



 Experience in SAP S/4 HANA utilities and Fiori; ability to analyze, debug and troubleshoot OData and web services used in integrations.
 



 Participates on an Application Development and Support team as well as project teams under the direction of their Lead SAP Configurator, Manager or Project Managers. Functions as Technical Lead on projects; may lead multiple concurrent projects.
 



 Subject matter expert in multiple business unit areas, including those relevant to projects and application support assignments.
 



 Considered a subject matter expert in their technical discipline; mentors and guides junior staff. Develops and drives standard practices within their team; collaborates with Business Systems Analysts and/or Business Partners to develop software specifications.
 



 Acquires and maintains appropriate technical skills and mentors junior staff. Participates in developing and driving standard practices within their team.
 



 Supports the request and analysis phases of SDLC by assisting with documentation and estimates. Executes the design, development, and implementation phases of SDLC by producing the prescribed deliverables; reviews deliverables produced by junior staff.
 



 Liaises with business partners and business unit leads to conduct analysis and design efforts for future enhancements and configuration to meet changing policy and legislative requirements.
 



 Maintains awareness of current trends in the business marketplace with a focus on product and service development, delivery and support, and applying key technologies. Examine trends in information systems training, materials and techniques. Coordinate system changes by identifying system requirements, definition, testing, training and implementation as well as provide specifications to work management systems, third party remittance, IT, and other areas of the organization.
 



 Participates in business process modeling sessions, while assisting in the collection and consolidation of required information and data in the development of analysis documentation in accordance with the SDLC methodology. Supports the creation of business process procedures for assigned business unit(s).
 



 Develops strong business and system knowledge relating to functional areas and assigned business unit(s). Supports the maintenance and evolution of the logical data model and business process model for assigned business unit(s). Provides input and direction on business unit technology strategies.
 



 Provide training and guidance and oversee work of staff/AMS contractors to ensure quality results.
 



 Development, growth, and mentoring of SAP Configurators.
 



 Should be able to perform budget, forecast, and calculate the actuals for project and maintain financials.

jobs.title: SAP S/4HANA BRIM Consultant
jobs.description:
**Job Role: SAP S/4HANA BRIM Consultant** 




**Location: Remote** 




**Key Requirement: SAP S4 BRIM Consultant with expertise in Convergent Mediation (CM)** 




  





**Role Summary:** 




 Serve as the primary functional consultant for SAP S/4HANA BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) in an Application Management Services (AMS) engagement. Own steady\-state support, incident and problem resolution, minor enhancements, and continuous improvement across subscription management, charging, billing, invoicing, and receivables processes, ensuring stable operations, business continuity, and SLA performance.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities (AMS\-Focused):** 




 Provide L2/L3 functional support for SAP BRIM (incidents, service requests, problems, changes) aligned to ITIL/AMS governance.
 



 Perform triage and root cause analysis for billing, charging, invoicing, subscription, and receivables\-related issues.
 



 Support and configure end\-to\-end BRIM processes:
 



 Primarily Convergent Mediation (CM) and usage data processing where applicable.
 



 Subscription Order Management (SOM) including subscription lifecycle management.
 



 Convergent Charging (CC) for usage\-based and recurring charging scenarios.
 



 Convergent Invoicing (CI) including billable item processing, invoicing, and bill generation.
 



 Contract Accounting and Receivables Management (FI\-CA) including collections, disputes, payment allocation, and account maintenance.
 



 Convergent Mediation (CM) and usage data processing where applicable.
 



 Revenue and order\-to\-cash processing integration with SAP S/4HANA.
 



 Manage minor enhancements and configuration changes including pricing, charging plans, invoicing rules, business partner setup, account determination, and collections processes.
 



 Support monitoring and controls including billing jobs, invoicing runs, charging processes, interface monitoring, reconciliation activities, and operational KPIs.
 



 Troubleshoot integration issues across BRIM, S/4HANA Finance, SAP SD, SAP BTP, middleware, and external subscription platforms.
 



 Partner with business stakeholders, finance teams, customer service teams, and IT teams to refine requirements, prioritize backlog, and deliver continuous improvements.
 



 Support release management activities including impact assessments, regression testing, UAT support, deployment validation, and hypercare.
 



 Maintain support artifacts including runbooks, SOPs, process flows, functional specifications, knowledge articles, and KT documentation.
 



  





**Required Functional Expertise:** 




 Strong hands\-on SAP S/4HANA experience in BRIM including:
 



 Subscription Order Management (SOM)
 



 Convergent Charging (CC)
 



 Convergent Invoicing (CI)
 



 Contract Accounting and Receivables Management (FI\-CA)
 



 Convergent Mediation (CM)
 



 Strong understanding of end\-to\-end Subscription\-to\-Cash (S2C) and Order\-to\-Cash (O2C) processes.
 



 Experience supporting integration touchpoints with:
 



 SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI/CO)
 



 SAP SD
 



 SAP BTP
 



 Middleware and API\-based integrations
 



 External subscription and billing platforms
 



 Experience working in an AMS model with SLA\-driven ticketing using ServiceNow, Jira, or similar tools.
 



 Strong experience in incident management, problem management, and structured RCA processes.
 



  





**Technical and Delivery Skills:** 




 Ability to translate business and production support issues into actionable requirements for technical teams (ABAP, Fiori, Integration, BTP, APIs).
 



 Experience with BRIM batch job monitoring, interface troubleshooting, reconciliation processes, and performance optimization.
 



 Experience supporting testing activities including SIT, UAT, and regression testing.
 



 Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in a fast\-paced support environment.
 



 Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting SLA commitments.
 



  





**Qualifications:**

Lead the design and implementation of SAP FICA solutions, ensuring they meet business requirements and industry best practices.  

* Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to define project scopes, goals, and deliverables.

jobs.title: Senior SAP FICA Specialist
jobs.description:
Role Description:

The Financial Systems team provides technology expertise to the finance department and is responsible for SAP, HANA, and connected 3rd party systems at Booking.com. We want to change the way people work with SAP, by building a finance application platform that supports simplification of business processes, and empowers the finance community with better financial insights.


We run our SAP environment on HANA and in February 2016 we migrated to Simple Finance. In 2019 we started our journey to S4 HANA.  

  

**Role Description**


As a FICA Specialist You will utilize your knowledge of SAP FICO and FICA/FICAx to design solutions which meet business objectives and goals.


You will participate in the development of solution design documents, functional design documents, configurational rationale, testing and deployment.


You will partner with business owners and digital teams to identify opportunities for improvement and offer up appropriate solution designs to meet business objectives


Through your experience of FICA/FICAx, you will translate business requirements into system configuration which meet business requirements.


You will have deep experience with the integration of FICA/FICAx to SAP FICO, Account Determination and Revenue Recognition.


This role involves extensive daily interaction with functional specialists, developers in all finance and IT departments in Booking.com. It is essential that you have a strong understanding of finance processes and integration with legacy systems and you have strong verbal/written communication and presentation skills in English.


Due to the rapid and continuous growth of the organization, the tasks and duties of this role may evolve over time. You will be keen to develop and grow within the role and to take on additional challenges and responsibilities as they occur.
